India district boundaries, for the People directory's Map in the admin panel.

From india_shp_2020 by Abhishek Bhatia (https://github.com/abhatia08/india_shp_2020),
which merges India Official Boundaries 2019
(https://github.com/justinelliotmeyers/India_Official_Boundaries_2019),
the Government of India's district units on India's official boundary.

735 districts in 37 states and union territories, as they stood in 2020.
Districts made since (for example Andhra Pradesh's new districts of 2022)
are drawn inside the district they came from.

Made with mapshaper: simplified to 1.5 percent of the points (every district
kept), coordinates to 3 decimal places (about 100 metres), with the district
name (d) and state (s) only. State lines (k: "state") are the borders
between districts of different states. Four district names cut short in the
source are written in full, and "&" is written "and".

The repository's code is under the MIT licence (LICENSE.txt). Its README says
the boundary data has no stated licence upstream. It is used here only inside
the admin panel, not on the public site.
